rationale.edition: Every changed path lives under web/src/** (components/traces, composables/traces, plugins/traces, utils/traces, lib/styles/tokens, locales) plus scripts/translations. None fall under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) or enterprise-gated modules, and no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbol names — this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out label (tests-added) was passed and the trigger comment is empty, so no human skip marker applies. The change is user-facing: it alters trace-waterfall/flame-graph rendering, which a user sees and interacts with, not a docs/CI/comment-only change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change introduces span-event severity markers (error/warning/info ticks) on span bars in the trace waterfall, the flame graph, and the span-details sidebar, plus an event-count badge and marker tooltips/clicks — new user-visible rendering and interaction that need verifying against a real trace view.
rationale.area: Traces. The bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/plugins/traces/ (SpanBlock, TraceDetails, TraceDetailsSidebar, TraceTree) and web/src/components/traces/ (FlameGraphView), and the sibling E2E specs (tracesSearch, traceDetails, traceQueryEditor, traceErrorFilter, traceAdvancedFiltering, tracesAnalyzeDimensions) all live in the Traces folder.
rationale.group: The Traces matrix shard (testfolder 'Traces', actual_folder 'Traces') in ci_matrix_env.json already runs all trace UI specs; this feature is a trace-details/waterfall behavior and belongs in that same group rather than a new shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The changed test files (FlameGraphView.spec.ts, useSpanEvents.spec.ts, SpanBlock.spec.ts, TraceDetails.spec.ts, TraceDetailsSidebar.spec.ts, TraceTree.spec.ts, spanPalette.spec.ts, traceColors.spec.ts) are Vitest unit specs under web/src/**, not E2E coverage, so no existing E2E tests to enhance.
